findings.title: Restore tail-coverage backstop so no changed file is skipped
findings.whyItBreaks: The PR deletes the tail-coverage backstop that guaranteed every changed file lands in some deep-reviewed hotspot. After `hotspots` is truncated to MAX_HOTSPOTS (6) at line 93, any changed file not assigned to a selected hotspot (including files in the 7th+ hotspot discarded by slice, and files map.md never mapped) is now never passed to deep.md and produces no residual_risks entry. The large-PR review can therefore return a verdict while whole changed files were never reviewed, with nothing surfacing the gap.

findings.title: Propagate deep-pass residual risks instead of emptying the list
findings.whyItBreaks: `candidateMerged.residual_risks` is now hard-coded to `[]`, discarding every residual risk reported by the successful deep passes (base pushed `res.residual_risks` into `residuals`). Those residual risks are exactly the deep reviewer's unresolved/blocking signals (ResidualRisk.blocks gates the verdict). The critic receives a candidate whose residual_risks are empty, so it can no longer carry forward unresolved risks, and a review that previously blocked on a deep-pass residual can now pass.

findings.title: Restore per-hotspot error handling in reviewLarge
findings.whyItBreaks: The try/catch around each hotspot's deep pass was removed, so a single hotspot failure (malformed/empty model output → extractJson/normalizeReview throws) now propagates out of the loop and rejects the whole reviewLarge call. Previously one bad hotspot degraded gracefully: the failure was recorded as a `blocks:true` residual, the verdict blocked, and the remaining hotspots were still deep-reviewed and reported. Now all completed hotspots' work is discarded and the caller gets a hard error instead of a blocked-but-informative result.

findings.title: Restore coverage backstop so unmapped changed files are reviewed
findings.whyItBreaks: The diff deletes the coverage backstop that collected every bundle.changedFiles path not present in a selected hotspot and pushed a tail hotspot so it still got deep-reviewed. `hotspots` is still truncated with `.slice(0, MAX_HOTSPOTS)` (MAX_HOTSPOTS = 6), so any file the map pass does not assign to the first six hotspots is now never deep-reviewed and nothing records that it was skipped (no residual, no checked entry). The removed comment stated the exact invariant now broken: 'never silently skip a changed file'. The head loop at lines 97-106 only iterates the (possibly truncated) hotspots.

findings.title: Preserve deep-pass residual_risks so blocking gaps reach the verdict
findings.whyItBreaks: Base code accumulated `residuals.push(...res.residual_risks)` per hotspot and passed them to the critic via `candidateMerged.residual_risks`. Head removes the `residuals` array and hardcodes `residual_risks: []`. deriveVerdict() returns `needs_human` when any residual has `blocks: true` (src/core/verdict.ts: `residualRisks.some(r => r.blocks)`); with deep residuals discarded and the critic never seeing them, a deep pass reporting a `blocks:true` gap can no longer influence the verdict, so `deriveVerdict(pruned.findings, pruned.residual_risks)` can return `pass`. This is TRIGGER D: an added/changed path discards a failure signal (a blocking gap) so callers can no longer distinguish 'gap found' from 'no gaps'.

findings.title: Keep BASE/HEAD substitution in critic prompts
findings.whyItBreaks: TRIGGER C contract drift. The critic prompt template promises the critic receives the base/head SHAs (prompts/critic.md: 'You receive candidate findings (JSON) plus the diff stat and the base/head SHAs' and its Refs block is literally `BASE: {{BASE}}` / `HEAD: {{HEAD}}`), instructing it to run `git diff <base>..<head> -- <file>`. This diff removes `.replace("{{BASE}}", ...)` and `.replace("{{HEAD}}", ...)` at BOTH critic call sites (reviewLarge, here; and reviewSmall, lines 59-61), so the critic is handed the literal strings `{{BASE}}`/`{{HEAD}}` and can no longer resolve the SHAs it is told to use for re-verification. Body (no substitution) contradicts the unchanged carrier (prompt spec) relied on by the critic.

findings.title: Restore coverage backstop so every changed file is deep-reviewed
findings.whyItBreaks: Base computed `covered` from the sliced hotspots, added every uncovered changed file to a synthetic "tail-coverage" hotspot, and deep-reviewed it (explicit comment: "never silently skip a changed file"). Head removed that block: after `sortByRisk(...).slice(0, MAX_HOTSPOTS)` (line 93) only the selected hotspots are iterated (line 97). Any changed file that the map pass did not assign to a hotspot, or that belongs to a hotspot ranked below MAX_HOTSPOTS=6, is now never deep-reviewed and never reported in `checked`, yet `reviewLarge` can still return a passing verdict — a silent under-review regression.

findings.title: Isolate deep-pass failures instead of aborting the whole review
findings.whyItBreaks: Base wrapped each deep pass in try/catch: on failure it recorded `[hotspot] DEEP PASS FAILED`, pushed a `{blocks:true}` residual, and continued with the remaining hotspots. Head removed the try/catch, so `runCodex`/`extractJson`/`normalizeReview` throwing for a single hotspot propagates out of `reviewLarge` and `review` rejects. One transient/flaky hotspot failure now destroys the entire review instead of yielding a partial result plus a blocking residual, so no findings/verdict are produced at all.

findings.title: Propagate deep-pass residual risks instead of hardcoding empty
findings.whyItBreaks: Base accumulated `residuals` from every deep pass (success: `residuals.push(...res.residual_risks)`; failure: a `{blocks:true}` entry) and forwarded them to the critic via `candidateMerged.residual_risks`. Head hardcodes `residual_risks: []`, discarding that signal before it reaches the critic. The final `residualRisks`/`deriveVerdict` call (line 122/128) only sees the critic's own list, so a blocking residual emitted by a deep pass can no longer force a blocking verdict — the failure/incompleteness is indistinguishable from "everything verified".
